findings.finding: An effective, open $30M Aegis ATM (prospectus supplement filed 2026-09-18) plus the Yorkville SEPA sit over a ~2.4M-share, ~$11M-cap float, and the issuer has already demonstrated it sells into volume: shares outstanding went from 28.84M (2026-08-17) to ~47.5M pre-split (2026-09-18), +65% in a month, so any bounce on 2026-09-29 meets registered supply.
findings.mechanism_in_window: The ATM is effective and needs no further filing to be drawn on 2026-09-29; today's $32.8M of dollar volume (~3x the market cap) is exactly the liquidity an ATM agent sells into, and ATM sales are only disclosed in the next periodic report (FY ends 2026-09-30, 10-K months away), so the draw lands in the window as price pressure without any announcement the tape can see first.
findings.resolves_by: 2026-09-29 — any ATM/SEPA sale in the next session
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Since the ATM and split: 09-23 fall -7.89% then +1.22%; 09-25 fall -15.89% then -8.73% (today). Share count +65% between 08-17 (10-Q cover, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/2038439/000173112226001099/e7849_10q.htm) and 09-18 while the stock fell ~94% over 60 sessions (baseline run_up_60d_pct -94.0).
findings.why_not_priced: The close holds today's selling but not tomorrow's issuance: an ATM of ~2.8x market cap cannot be exhausted in one session, and the float is small enough that a single day's draw is a material share of it. If the price held the supply, the post-split bounces (09-24 spike above $6) would not have been sold straight back down on 09-25 and 09-28; a priced ATM would show a stable price on falling volume, not 43x volume on a further gap down.
findings.independence: The company's own 09-28 07:00 ET release lists 'significant shareholder dilution from ongoing financing' among its risks (https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2026/09/28/3369743/0/en/visionwave-highlights-stratum-autonomous-ground-systems-platform-for-multi-mission-defense-operations.html); the 424B5 itself lists the YA II SEPA and convertible notes (up to $50M) as concurrent issuance; ATM 8-K https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/2038439/000173112226001264/e7954_8k.htm

outside_window.finding: $20M VARAN purchase order: conditions precedent (customer proof of financing, bank guarantee, export licences, compliance review) unsatisfied, no date; $2M advance due only 5 business days after guarantee confirmation. Upside if confirmed, undated.

YA II debenture (conversion fixed at $5.00 pre-split, floor $0.702 pre-split, VWAP-based after an Event of Default); first $1.75M monthly installment 2027-01-30, maturity 2027-07-20 - a further supply/solvency leg later.

Working-capital deficit $33.26M and cash $4.88M at 2026-06-30; going concern addressed only by a Stanley Hills support commitment through 2027-08-28. Structural pressure, no dated trigger inside the window.
